# Trump11 fixture notice

`trump11.json` is an offline numerical reconstruction of the eleven-square
construction attributed to Walter Trump (1979). The reconstruction follows the
closed-form equations recorded by David Ellsworth and preserved by Joshua
Levy and The Squares Project.

Source repository: <https://github.com/jlevy/squares>
